scripts.package: echo 'building binaries...' && cd src && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 asdf exec go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/action-amd64 main.go && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 asdf exec go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/action-arm64 main.go
scripts.fmt: cd src && asdf exec go fmt ./...
scripts.test: cd src && asdf exec go test -v ./...
scripts.test:coverage: cd src && asdf exec go test -coverprofile=cover.out ./... && asdf exec go tool cover -html=cover.out
